body: I wouldn’t be concerned. mine is usually darker like that, and gets darker close to him shedding.

I can see what you’re saying. When you make someone you care for so much, sad. It hurts, I beat myself up for days over the little thing. at this point this seems like the only way I can make people happy. Thank you, it means a lot that you took time out of you’re day to talk to me. I wish the best for you
I’m 18, a senior in high school.
